$comment: Nexus - canonical Agent Metadata Template (one object per agent). Fill what you know; fields marked optional can stay empty. Agent owners may instead supply the simpler intake format shown in docs/agent-metadata-template.md; Nexus normalises both.
id: required. Stable slug: lowercase, hyphens. Example: kyc-verification-agent
name: required. Display name. Example: KYC Verification Agent
tagline: required. One sentence under 90 characters: what it does for the user
description: required. 2-4 sentences: what it is and how it works at a high level
problem_solved: optional but valuable. Why it exists / the business problem it removes
business_domains: required. One or more: Onboarding, Compliance, Collections, Cards, Lending, Fraud & Risk, Legal, Operations, Customer Service, Engineering
use_cases: required. Concrete tasks in plain language. Example: Review customer onboarding documents for completeness
personas: required. Target personas: business_user, compliance_user, risk_analyst, operations_user, developer (labels like 'Compliance User' are accepted)
capabilities: required. What it can do. Examples: Document extraction, Identity verification, Summarisation, Risk scoring
services: optional. Services it exposes to other systems, if any
example_tasks: optional. Literal prompts a user could give it
tags: optional. Extra search keywords. Examples: kyc, onboarding, ocr
category: required for carousels. One of: Compliance & Risk, Document Intelligence, Customer Operations, Knowledge & Policy, Developer Tools (derived from domain if omitted)
platform: required. Where it runs. Examples: AWS Bedrock Agents, Azure AI Foundry, Microsoft Agent 365, Internal service
tools_services: optional. Systems and tools it calls. Examples: OCR service, Sanctions API, ServiceNow
models: optional. Models used. Examples: Claude Opus 5, GPT-5, In-house classifier
architecture_pattern: optional. Name of the reference pattern. Example: Document agent

owner.name: optional. Accountable person
owner.email: optional but recommended. Contact for access and collaboration

status: required. production | pilot | beta | in_development | deprecated

access.how: required. One sentence: how an employee gets access
access.launch_url: optional. Opens the agent when the user already has access
access.request_url: optional. Access request form or ticket

architecture_url: optional. Architecture pattern or design doc

documents.type: optional. A document type from data/knowledge-sources.json: brd, asd, hld or lld
documents.system: optional. Where it lives, from the same file: confluence, sharepoint, jira, servicenow or documents
documents.url: optional. A link to the document where it lives. Nexus links to it and keeps no copy
documents.description: optional. What this document covers, so a reader knows what they will open. Up to 300 characters

audience_groups: required for enterprise. Explicit allowed directory groups; empty denies all.
active: required for enterprise. Boolean; false hides listing.
review_status: required for enterprise. draft | approved | retired. Only approved is visible.
source_kind: sample | enterprise. Sample destinations are not presented as live integrations.
